CraftSearch.Title: Find a sequence
CraftSearch.Limits: Limits: {0} steps · {1} states per step · {2:N0} transitions
CraftSearch.TargetHelp: A zero target prioritizes progress. Reaching a numeric quality target does not guarantee HQ in game.
CraftSearch.Priority: After reaching the target, minimize total waits, then action count. Bounded search cannot guarantee a global optimum when states are discarded.
CraftSearch.Pruned: States were discarded to respect the search width.
CraftSearch.LimitReached: Calculation limit reached. You can increase the limits and search again.
CraftSearch.NoResult: No completed synthesis found within this bounded search.
CraftSearch.UseHelp: This replaces the simulator sequence. Inspect the steps and prepare macro text before trying it in game.

CraftSearchResults.Description: Find a completed synthesis reaching the target under normal conditions. Bounded search across {0} modeled actions: a proposal is not a universal optimum, and no result does not prove impossibility.
CraftSearchResults.Waits: Planned waits: {0} s · actual duration also depends on latency and pauses between blocks.
CraftSearchResults.Statistics: {0:N0} transitions examined · depth {1} · calculated at {2} (PC local time)
CraftSearchResults.Error: The search failed. See the Dalamud log for details.

CraftConditions.Title: Quality variations · fixed sequence
CraftConditions.Help: This sequence starts in Normal condition. The range covers ordinary model transitions: Good and Poor return to Normal; Excellent forces Poor. Actions remain identical. No probability or HQ guarantee; special recipes and unmodeled effects are excluded.
CraftConditions.BoundsHelp: Progress, durability and CP remain those of the Normal simulation. Final bounds follow coherent condition paths; individual step minima do not necessarily belong to the same path.
CraftConditions.Incomplete: Incomplete or invalid sequence: the range covers only actions actually simulated.
CraftConditions.Error: Quality variations cannot be calculated for this scenario. Technical details are available in developer mode.

InterfaceHelp.PriceHelp: Disabled by default. After a stable hover, queries Universalis using only public item and world IDs. Shared cache and at most one network request every three seconds across manual and hover price requests.
InterfaceHelp.MonsterHoverHelp: Enabled by default, together with item uses. Monsters already cached show at once; otherwise one Console Games Wiki request is sent after hovering the same material for 1.5 s (ingredient, leather, bone, cloth, reagent, stone, metal, lumber; neither crafted nor gathered) (one at a time, at least 3 s apart). Untick to use the cache only.
InterfaceHelp.UsageHelp: Disabled by default. Shows recipe, leve, Grand Company delivery and aquarium references after a stable hover. Uses game data without enabling prices or making a network request. Both options share one panel.
InterfaceHelp.MenuHelp: Disabled by default. The Tensho submenu opens uses, stocks, crafting, gathering sources or tools for the chosen item. This menu does not request prices. Chat links and special items are not covered.

CacheUi.Title: Cache & expiry
CacheUi.Help: Data is stored on disk. Look up reuses fresh cache; Refresh forces an update. Shorter retention also applies to existing cached entries.
CacheUi.Collections: Collections · blue magic, cards, titles, achievements…
CacheUi.QuestHelp: Quests and collections refresh on expiry, character change or Refresh. Newly detected acquisitions also invalidate collection observations.
CacheUi.StockHelp: Retainers and chocobo require manual imports with their inventory open. Expiry marks old observations without deleting items or importing automatically.
CacheUi.NativeHelp: Game catalogues are loaded once and shared in memory. Reloading or changing game version or language rebuilds them from game files.
CacheUi.LiveHelp: Live inventory, attributes, synthesis and mini-games use short context-bound caches. Macro calculations and forecasts are reused while their inputs remain unchanged.

MacroUi.Description: Choose game macros, then explicitly start their sequence

MacroUi.StopHelp: Stopping removes subsequent steps; the current macro may finish in game. No automatic resumption after interruption or character change.

ToolDetails.Uses: Recipes, crafting leves, potential Grand Company deliveries, aquariums, orchestrion rolls and quest rewards. Variants and unknown states remain visible; daily requests and quest availability are not inferred.
ToolDetails.Fashion: Browse native Fashion Report hints and equipment linked by community observations. Choose the in-game hint manually and filter by equipment slot. Source dates are shown; weekly hints, scores and dyes are not inferred.
ToolDetails.Gp: Compare a manual MIN/BTN scenario with already paid effects and a first-attempt bonus. Optional node observation can copy GP, level and attempts. Starting values and effects remain manual; regeneration, restoration, procs, crystals and collectables are outside the model.
ToolDetails.Monsters: Fetch monster associations for the selected material manually. Garland Tools lists and details include dates, levels, locations, zone maps and selectable items. Coverage is partial; drop rates and live presence are not inferred. A separate wiki lookup can be cached.
ToolDetails.Duties: Manually fetch listed Garland Tools loot for a duty from the native catalog. Dated cache, chest categories and rewards remain separate. Items share the selected-item context. Coverage is partial; no drop rates are inferred.
ToolDetails.Triad: Browse cards and acquisitions, build a deck and request manual advice with two known hands. Supports Reverse, Fallen Ace, Same/Plus and combos, Order, Ascension and Descension. Optional experimental observation reads UI faces; it does not establish native identities or rules and does not generate automatic advice.
ToolDetails.Macros: Experimental sequences of personal and shared macros. Each selected macro must end with /tenshonext. Start manually; saved macros are never changed automatically. In-game validation is required.
ToolDetails.Maps: Browse native maps, search regions and zones, enter coordinates and save favorite markers. Load, edit or open favorites and find resources for the zone. Automatic markers remain unfinished.
ToolDetails.Cactpot: Exact solver for a manually entered ticket, with optional experimental observation of the in-game ticket. Advice updates after each revealed number; no automatic clicks.
ToolDetails.Character: Observed native character attributes for combat, crafting and gathering. Derived effects and formulas remain unfinished.
ToolDetails.Blue: Native spellbook, confirmed learned spells, numbers, ranks, descriptions and listed locations. Missing sources and learning conditions remain incomplete.
ToolDetails.Quests: Native catalog and categories, confirmed progress, prerequisites, follow-up quests and variant rewards. Item uses link to quests offering that item. Links do not prove availability; other conditions, stages and resets still need verification.
ToolDetails.Market: NQ/HQ prices for the current world with dates and a shared cache. Compare direct ingredient costs and terminal chain requirements with manual batch lookup. Hover prices are optional in Settings and disabled by default.
ToolDetails.Collections: Mounts, minions, emotes, cards, orchestrion, titles and achievements, with categories, details and linked rewards. Titles and achievements are confirmed unacquired only when a complete stable list is received; otherwise their state remains unknown. No automatic unlocking or reward claims.
ToolDetails.Sorting: Profiles per character and storage, with reusable templates of matching geometry. Priority criteria, protected or filtered zones, bidirectional filling and previews preserving empty slots. Apply explicitly to bags or open storage after live reading. Loading a template does not start sorting. Item type metadata does not prove stack marketability or character equipment eligibility. Native behavior needs in-game validation.
ToolDetails.Gathering: Gathering and fishing sources, filters, maps, Eorzea/local schedules and zone weather. Native fishing log descriptions, restrictions and tomes do not prove catches or unlocks. Fetch bait chains and location conditions manually from Garland Tools, using the shared item cache. Calculate windows from stated time and weather criteria; missing criteria and uncertain results stay visible. No catch is guaranteed. Optional MIN/BTN observation.
ToolDetails.Craft: Recipes, preparation, simulation and search, saved sequences and macro export. The companion panel follows the selected crafting-log recipe, compares saved sequences and suggests a macro to copy. Synthesis observation compares the next action in ordinary conditions; it never executes an action. Special recipes and native adaptive rotations remain unfinished.
ToolDetails.Bank: The bank combines complete retainer and saddlebag imports. Click an item to share it with other tools. Snapshots must be imported again after transfers.
